there would have remained in the field an area required for sowing nine kav of seed, … And … a garden, … an area required for sowing a half-kav of seed,

there would have remained in the field an area required for sowing nine kav of seed, the smallest area of land worth working. In that case, the orphans can reasonably claim that they are unwilling to give up on the land that belongs to them. However, if the error is less than this, it is enough if she returns the remainder to the orphans. And in the case of a garden, the sale is void if, had there been no error, there would have remained an area required for sowing a half-kav of seed,
Or, according to the statement of Rabbi Akiva, an area required for sowing a quarter-kav of seed.
